name: Fear Aura
description: Each creature of the creature’s choice that starts its turn within 20 feet of the creature must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw unless the creature is incapacitated. On a failed save, the creature is frightened until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature is immune to this golem’s Fear Aura for the next 24 hours.
